summary: The refined protocol suggests a cocktail of TTN-AS1, PRKCE, SLC8A1-AS1, and HSPB1 to rejuvenate aged ventricular cardiomyocytes. TTN-AS1 and PRKCE are upregulated in youth and support sarcomere stability and cardioprotective signaling, respectively. SLC8A1-AS1 aids calcium homeostasis, while HSPB1, despite being upregulated in aged cells, may help manage proteotoxic stress. This combination aims to restore youthful cardiac function without inducing pluripotency or oncogenesis.
query_interpretation: Identify a gene cocktail that enhances youthful cardiac function by stabilizing sarcomere structure, supporting calcium homeostasis, and managing stress responses, while avoiding pluripotency and oncogenic pathways.
refinement_notes: The selection focused on genes with known roles in cardiac function and stress response, excluding pluripotency and oncogenic drivers. HSPB1 was included despite its aging association due to its potential role in stress management.
judge_reasoning: Panel B best addresses the research question by including genes that enhance calcium handling and cardiac resilience while also targeting aging markers and stress responses. The inclusion of HSPB1, CRYAB, DUSP1, and MYL2 provides a more comprehensive approach to mitigating senescence and stress-related pathways, aligning well with the objectives of the study.
cell_type_label: Regular Ventricular Cardiac Myocyte (125,289 cells | Litviňuková et al. 2020, 14 donors)
query: Identify a non-pluripotent 3-to-4 factor transcription and chromatin regulator cocktail for aged human Ventricular Cardiomyocytes (donors >= 65 years) that simultaneously: (1) restores diastolic calcium reuptake and sarcoplasmic reticulum stability by upregulating ATP2A2 (SERCA2a) and stabilizing RYR2/SLC8A1 without depressing SCN5A or GJA1 (Connexin-43) gap junction conduction; (2) reverses age-associated depletion of endogenous cardiac longevity regulators (ZBTB16, FOXO3, MEF2C, PPARGC1A); and (3) suppresses senescence-associated cell-cycle arrest (CDKN1A/p21, CDKN2A/p16) while keeping pluripotency and oncogenic drivers (POU5F1, SOX2, NANOG, MYC) below baseline thresholds. Report predicted log-expression shifts for GJA1, ATP2A2, RYR2, SCN5A, and MYH7.

arrhythmia_safety.reason: Stable Conduction: Normal ECG synchrony and integration. Cocktail approved for wet-lab validation.
